subject: Strategy Workshop — presenter blocks, timing, and pre-read stitch
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Eliza Turner <eliza.turner@stratacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Strategy Workshop — presenter blocks, timing, and pre-read stitch

Team — kicking off the thread to land the final presenter blocks and the pre-read bundle for next month's onsite with StrataCorp. High-level asks: 1) confirm who owns each 25/40/60 min block, 2) lock transitions (10 min handoffs between sessions), 3) finalize pre-read one-pager and decide what goes into the short vs. deep pack.

Quick constraints from Eliza (their exec sponsor): arrival breakfast at 08:30, first session starts at 09:15, lunch 12:15-13:15, end by 16:30. They want a single PDF pre-read (5 pages max) plus an optional appendix zip.

I've attached the latest roster and an agenda timing spreadsheet (agenda_timing_v2.xlsx). Please do the following today:
- Marcus: assign leads for the 09:15 and 10:05 blocks and add 1-sentence intent for each slot in the roster spreadsheet.
- Irene: draft the 1-page summary for the pre-read (we'll then expand to 5 pages). Target: first draft by EOD.
- I'll own the wrap / success metrics slide and coordinate logistics with Eliza.

Also flagging that procurement asked for an invoice timeline — Eliza, can you confirm who on your side we should loop in?

Thanks — Mina
--
Mina Haddad
Director, Strategic Engagements
Redwood Inference
Attach: StrataCorp_Workshop_Roster_v0.3.xlsx; agenda_timing_v2.xlsx

From: Eliza Turner <eliza.turner@stratacorp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@stratacorp.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@stratacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Strategy Workshop — presenter blocks, timing, and pre-read stitch

Thanks, Mina — appreciate the clear asks. A few notes from our side:
- Confirmed arrival / start times look good.
- For procurement, loop in Angela Park (angela.park@stratacorp.com) for contract/invoice timing.
- Audience: ~18 people (VP+ directors). Two internal presenters will join: our CTO (Tom Nguyen) will co-present the 10:05 slot and our Head of Ops (Raj Patel) will be a panellist in the 14:00 slot.

On the pre-read: CTO asked that we include a short tech appendix (2 slides) with current cloud spend benchmarks. If you can accept an appendix zip, we'll add that. Otherwise keep the main PDF to 5 pages as requested.

Two small timing asks: could we compress the 11:20 workshop to 35 minutes and extend the 14:00 panel to 50 minutes? That would help our execs. Open to swapping ownership to make that work.

Eliza
Eliza Turner
Director, Strategic Partnerships
StrataCorp

Great — updated roster and slot ownership in the attached spreadsheet. Notes:
- 09:15 (Opening context): Mina + Product PM (assigned: Aisha Rahman). Intent: frame customer challenges and desired outcomes (10 min sec framing + 15 min context).
- 10:05 (Tech deep dive): Marcus + Tom Nguyen (StrataCorp) — assigned Marcus as lead for logistics and slide flow; Tom will present architecture choices.
- 11:20 (Working session): shifted to 35 min; owner is Irene + Solutions lead (Priya N.). I left a 10-min transition to lunch.
- 14:00 (Panel): extended to 50 min — panelists: Raj Patel (StrataCorp), Marcus, Irene; format: 30-min moderated Q&A + 20-min breakouts.

Irene — I added 1-sentence intents in the roster. Please review the language; I kept it outcome-oriented.

Attached is the first draft of the one-page pre-read summary (draft_pre-read_pack_v1.pdf). Key callouts: objectives, baseline metrics, agenda snapshot, and ask of the execs. I've kept the technical appendix as a separate file we can zip.

A few asks to finalize:
- Mina: can you add the success metrics and our 3 recommended rollout options (short bullets) by COB Tuesday so I can expand to the 5-page pack?
- Marcus: please drop the slide deck outline for the tech deep dive (3 slides) into the Drive folder; I'll pull the images into the appendix.
- Eliza: confirm acceptance of appendix zip. If yes, we'll include 2 slides: cloud spend benchmarks + architecture diagram.

One more note — for transitions, recommend we keep 10-minute buffer and use the short intro template (attached in Drive). If any presenter needs a lapel mic or HDMI dongle, flag with logistics team.

Thanks — Irene
Senior Product Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference
Attach: draft_pre-read_pack_v1.pdf
